## Load and combine sample data

```{r}
#reading the seruat objects
B006 <- readRDS("B006_seurat.rds")
B008 <- readRDS("B008_seurat.rds")
B010 <- readRDS("B010_seruat.rds")
B011 <- readRDS("B011_seurat.rds")
B012 <- readRDS("B012_seurat.rds")



B006$donor <- "B006"
B008$donor <- "B008"
B010$donor <- "B010"
B011$donor <- "B011"
B012$donor <- "B012"


EC <- merge(
  x = B006,
  y = list(B008, B010, B011, B012),
  add.cell.ids = c("B006","B008","B010","B011","B012"),
  project = "AllDonors"
)

# checking if meta data was perserved
table(EC$donor)

dim(EC) # dim before subsetting
```

## Subsetting

```{r}

set.seed(123)

cells.use <- unlist(
  lapply(
    split(Cells(EC), EC$donor),
    function(x) sample(x, 8000)
  )
)

EC <- subset(EC, cells = cells.use)

dim(EC) # dim subsetting
```

## QC

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Seurat)
    library(Signac)
    library(GenomeInfoDb)
    library(stringr)
    library(rtracklayer)
    library(GenomicRanges)
  })

source("./functions.R")
sample_path <- "/home/projects/exam_2026_22102/group2/intestine_data/sample_seurats/" #dir with individual sample seurat objects.
```

### B006-A-002

```{r}
sample_name <- "B006-A-002"
SampleSeurat <- readRDS(str_c(sample_path, sample_name, "_seurat.rds"))
DefaultAssay(SampleSeurat) <- "RNA"

# Show QC metrics for the first 5 cells
head(SampleSeurat@meta.data, 5)
```

Check for NAs

```{r}
table(is.na(SampleSeurat$percent.hb))
```

Dimensions before filtering

```{r}
print(dim(SampleSeurat))
```

**Adding mitochondrial, hemoglobin & ribosomal genes**

```{r}
#Mitochondrial genes
SampleSeurat@meta.data[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(SampleSeurat, pattern = "^MT-")

#Hemoglobin genes
hemo_gene_names <- grep("^HB", rownames(SampleSeurat), value = TRUE) 
hemo_gene_names <- filter_hemoglobin_genes(hemo_gene_names) # Filter hemoglobin genes based on function
SampleSeurat@meta.data[["percent.hb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(SampleSeurat, features=hemo_gene_names)

#Ribosomal genes
ribo_large <- grep("^RPL", rownames(SampleSeurat), value = TRUE)
ribo_small <- grep("^RPL", rownames(SampleSeurat), value = TRUE)
ribo_genes <- c(ribo_large, ribo_small)
SampleSeurat@meta.data[["percent.rb"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(SampleSeurat, feature=ribo_genes)
```

Visualize QC metrics

```{r}
# Visualize QC metrics as a violin plot
VlnPlot(SampleSeurat, 
        features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt", "percent.hb", "percent.rb"),
        ncol = 5, 
        pt.size = 0.5,
        alpha = 0.05)
```
